question: Maithili Thakur and Lydian Nadhaswaram were bestowed with Sur Jyotsna National Music Awards ________.
solution:
The correct answer is **__2021.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Talented singer Maithili Thakur and young musician Lydian Nadhaswaram, are the winners of the 8th edition of Sur Jyotsna National Music Awards 2021.
 
• She was honoured at the hands of **Union Information and Broadcasting minister Anurag Singh Thakur** at a glittering award ceremony at Kamani Auditorium.
 
• Maithili Thakur is an Indian playback singer trained in Indian classical music and Folk Music. 
 
• She has sung original songs, covers, and traditional folk music prominently in Hindi, Bengali, Maithili, Urdu, Marathi, Bhojpuri, Punjabi, Tamil, English, and more Indic languages.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Sur Jyotsna National Music Awards (SJNMA) is **one of the most definitive platforms that honour aspiring young talent in Indian Classical & Popular music**.
 
• Instituted by the Lokmat Media Group in memory of Late Smt. Jyotsna Darda, SJNMA's mission is to identify and recognize music talent at the National level.
